verdict.rationale: Netlify's integrations directory lists ready-made starters and templates for common use cases: a Remix + Supabase starter, a bare-bones Angular project built to deploy quickly to Netlify, and a production-ready Clerk B2C auth template. This covers the core of the story. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of a one-click deploy flow (e.g. a Deploy-to-Netlify button), a documented template gallery covering a breadth of use cases, and independent or hands-on corroboration of deploying a template.
